title: picomatch.scan returns incomplete pattern parts
prompt: Our picomatch.scan(pattern, { parts: true }) in lib/scan.js is supposed to return the path segments of a glob in its parts list. For several inputs the parts are incomplete: patterns with no path separator such as '*', '.*', '{1..9}', 'c!(.)z' or the empty string give an empty parts list instead of one part, a lone or leading slash like '/' or '/*' loses its empty first part, and an escaped slash inside a pattern like '/dev\/@(tcp|udp)\/*\/*' must not be treated as a separator. Please make the parts list always cover the whole pattern.
